apple_source_selection: The archive expands the upstream src symlink into duplicate engine trees. The unchanged Swift package manifests exclude those trees from compilation and use them only as lifecycle header search paths. Retain the two required headers; hook/build.dart builds the shared top-level src tree on all native targets.

patches.change: Include <malloc.h> in the _MSC_VER branch to declare _alloca on Windows ARM64, without relying on incidental SSE header inclusion.
patches.scope: Declaration only: preserve ARM64 NEON, FFT scratch allocation, native hook architecture selection, codecs, APIs and all other platform implementations.

licensing: Original LICENSE, AUTHORS, nested licenses and embedded source notices are retained.
